label: Measure First
question: Can a coding agent find the hidden useful improvement when it must prove a real local deficit before it is allowed to keep a patch?

frozen_history.rule: Historical arms are frozen and are not rerun.

forbidden: candidate proximity hints from prior hidden runs

mandatory_before_code: list at least three concrete opportunities
attach a numeric local probe to each serious opportunity
identify the exact lever and declared files
select one target and freeze it before implementation
mandatory_before_hidden_evaluation: same probe reproduces on untouched baseline and candidate
candidate improves its own probe by more than its declared epsilon
patch stays within two files and 120 changed lines

power_check.passing_condition: A measured one-file performance opportunity ranks ahead of an unmeasured four-file cleanup.

success: At least one Measure First candidate earns a unique winner under the unchanged frozen SELF-001 evaluator.
invalid: Broken substrate, infrastructure failure, selector mismatch, or bundle boundary failure.
stopping_rule: One prospective run. Do not tune the prompt, probe rules, scope limits, or evaluator after seeing the result.
